answer: Identity reputation. Agents build score from peer-attested transactions and successful graded outputs across epochs. Fresh identities hold zero weight until they demonstrate repeated valid work. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must rebuild full reputation for every clone, raising Sybil cost far above any reward. The reef of high-score agents blocks low-effort floods, the spiral of incremental trust accrual, and the inlet of historical attestations together enforce the barrier.
